note: Short bhajans played after the car-start welcome (Settings > When the car starts > Bhajan). Only Ampli's own original recordings go here: no third-party audio or lyrics. Each entry needs bhajan/<id>.mp3 next to this file; until it is added, the app skips that bhajan quietly. 'original' must be true or the entry is ignored. 'free': the one bhajan free users get. 'days': the days it plays by default (MON..SUN).
